annotations.title: Wash Australian numbers (Do Not Call Register)

description: Wash Australian phone numbers against the Do Not Call Register. Needs a live account (an OAuth sign-in or a tpsc_live_ key), as the register has no test mode. One prepaid AU wash per distinct valid number; invalid numbers cost nothing and numbers the register gave no answer for are refunded. Same as POST /v1/dncr.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers, up to 500 per call, for example "+61412345678".
